<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  // ==========================================
  // 1. FORMULARIO Y CONFIGURACIÓN
  // ==========================================

  const form = document.querySelector(
    'form.elementor-form[name="Request Information"]'
  );

  if (!form) {
    console.error("SABER: Formulario no encontrado.");
    return;
  }

  const API_URL = "https://api.verityiq.com/api/leadpost";

  const TEST_MODE = false;

  const THANK_YOU_URL = "/thank-you/";

  const CONFIG = {
    veritySysKey: "vliffv08",
    tenantid: "85",
    schoolname: "Saber College",
    campus: "Miami",
    campaignname: "Request Info Website",
    pub_id: "Saber",
    CPL: "Saber"
  };

  const getField = (id) =>
    form.querySelector("#form-field-" + id);

  const getValue = (id) =>
    (getField(id)?.value || "").trim();

  const params = new URLSearchParams(
    window.location.search
  );

  // ==========================================
  // 2. FUNCIONES AUXILIARES
  // ==========================================

  function normalizePhone(value) {
    let digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "");

    if (
      digits.length === 11 &&
      digits.startsWith("1")
    ) {
      digits = digits.slice(1);
    }

    return digits;
  }

  function generateLeadId() {
    if (window.crypto && crypto.randomUUID) {
      return "M" + crypto.randomUUID();
    }

    return "M" + Date.now().toString();
  }

  function getCampaign() {
    const source = (
      params.get("utm_source") || ""
    ).toLowerCase();

    const medium = (
      params.get("utm_medium") || ""
    ).toLowerCase();

    const isPaid =
      ["cpc", "ppc", "paid", "paid_search"].includes(medium) ||
      ["google_ads", "googleads"].includes(source);

    return {
      campaigntype: isPaid
        ? "Paid Search"
        : "Organic SEO",

      campaigncode: isPaid
        ? "Google Ads Landing Page"
        : "Request Info Website",

      leadsource: isPaid
        ? "Google"
        : "Website"
    };
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 3. CONSTRUIR DATOS DEL LEAD
  // ==========================================

  function createLead() {
    const campaign = getCampaign();

    const lead = {
      ...CONFIG,

      campaigntype: campaign.campaigntype,
      campaigncode: campaign.campaigncode,
      leadsource: campaign.leadsource,

      leadid: generateLeadId(),

      fname: getValue("fname"),
      lname: getValue("lname"),
      email: getValue("email"),

      phone: normalizePhone(
        getValue("phone")
      ),

      address: getValue("street"),
      city: getValue("city"),
      zip: getValue("zip"),

      program: getValue("program"),

      consent: "yes"
    };

    // Agregar parámetros de seguimiento
    [
      "utm_source",
      "utm_medium",
      "utm_campaign",
      "utm_content",
      "utm_term",
      "utm_device",
      "utm_matchtype",
      "Code_Id",
      "adposition",
      "creative_id",
      "network",
      "gclid",
      "fbclid"
    ].forEach((key) => {
      const value = params.get(key);

      if (value) {
        lead[key] = value;
      }
    });

    return lead;
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 4. VALIDACIONES
  // ==========================================

  function validateLead(lead) {

    if (!lead.fname || !lead.lname) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please enter your full name."
      );
    }

    if (
      !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(
        lead.email
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please enter a valid email address."
      );
    }

    if (
      !/^[2-9]\d{2}[2-9]\d{6}$/.test(
        lead.phone
      )
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please enter a valid US phone number."
      );
    }

    if (!lead.program) {
      throw new Error(
        "Please select a program."
      );
    }

  }

  // ==========================================
  // 5. LIMPIAR FORMULARIO
  // ==========================================

  function clearForm() {

    form.reset();

    // Limpiar campos visibles.
    [
      "fname",
      "lname",
      "email",
      "phone"
    ].forEach((id) => {
      const input = getField(id);

      if (input) {
        input.value = "";
      }
    });

    // Mantener program y campus porque son
    // campos ocultos configurados en Elementor.

    // Actualizar intl-tel-input si está disponible.
    const phoneInput = getField("phone");

    if (
      phoneInput &&
      window.intlTelInput &&
      typeof window.intlTelInput.getInstance === "function"
    ) {
      const instance =
        window.intlTelInput.getInstance(phoneInput);

      if (instance) {
        instance.setNumber("");
      }
    }
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 6. ENVÍO A VERITY IQ
  // ==========================================

  let submitting = false;

  form.addEventListener("submit", async function (event) {

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();

    if (submitting) return;

    const button = form.querySelector(
      '[type="submit"]'
    );

    try {

      const lead = createLead();

      validateLead(lead);

      if (TEST_MODE) {
        console.table(lead);

        alert(
          "Test mode: no lead was sent."
        );

        return;
      }

      submitting = true;

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = true;
      }

      // Enviar datos a Verity IQ
      const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
        },
        body: new URLSearchParams(lead).toString()
      });

      const result = await response.text();

      console.log(
        "VERITY HTTP STATUS:",
        response.status
      );

      console.log(
        "VERITY RESPONSE:",
        result
      );

      // Validar respuesta HTTP
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          "Verity IQ HTTP error: " +
          response.status
        );
      }

      // Verity puede devolver "success" como texto
      // o como cadena JSON.
      let parsedResult = result;

      try {
        parsedResult = JSON.parse(result);
      } catch (e) {
        // La respuesta no es JSON.
      }

      const isSuccess =
        typeof parsedResult === "string" &&
        parsedResult.trim().toLowerCase() === "success";

      if (!isSuccess) {
        throw new Error(
          "Verity IQ did not confirm success."
        );
      }

      // ======================================
      // 7. ENVÍO EXITOSO
      // ======================================

      console.log(
        "SABER: Lead enviado correctamente."
      );

      // Evento de conversión para GTM.
      if (window.dataLayer) {
        window.dataLayer.push({
          event: "formSubmission",
          formName: "formProfessionalNursing",
          formCampus: lead.campus,
          formProgram: lead.program,
          leadId: lead.leadid,

          utm_source: lead.utm_source || "",
          utm_medium: lead.utm_medium || "",
          utm_campaign: lead.utm_campaign || ""
        });
      }

      // Limpiar los campos del formulario.
      clearForm();

      // Redireccionar a la página de gracias.
      window.location.assign(THANK_YOU_URL);

    } catch (error) {

      console.error(
        "SABER VERITY ERROR:",
        error
      );

      alert(
        "We couldn't process your request. " +
        "Please try again."
      );

    } finally {

      submitting = false;

      if (button) {
        button.disabled = false;
      }

    }

  }, true);

});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const input = document.querySelector("#form-field-phone");

  if (!input) return;

  /*
   * Bloquea escritura manual de indicativos distintos a +1
   * Ejemplo bloqueado: +57, +52, +34, +44
   */
  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    const value = input.value.trim();

    if (value.startsWith("+") && !value.startsWith("+1")) {
      input.value = "+1";
    }
  });

  /*
   * Bloquea pegado de indicativos distintos a +1
   */
  input.addEventListener("paste", function (event) {
    const pastedText = (event.clipboardData || window.clipboardData)
      .getData("text")
      .trim();

    if (pastedText.startsWith("+") && !pastedText.startsWith("+1")) {
      event.preventDefault();
      input.value = "+1";
      alert("Only US phone numbers starting with +1 are allowed.");
    }
  });

});
</script>

settings.title: Physical Therapist Assistant A.S. Degree Program Overview

settings.editor:
The Associate of Science in Physical Therapist Assistant at SABER College
prepares students with the clinical knowledge, technical skills, and
supervised practical experience needed to assist physical therapists in
restoring patient movement and function. Students complete theoretical
instruction, hands-on lab training, and supervised clinical education.

This integrated learning model ensures graduates are ready to support
patient care and contribute effectively within physical therapy settings.

image.alt: Physical therapist assistant helping a patient practice walking

settings.title: Why Choose the Physical Therapist Assistant A.S. Program at SABER College?​

settings.editor: Comprehensive curriculum integrating theory + clinical training​
Structured learning through classroom instruction and on-campus labs​
Real-world experience through supervised clinical education​
Supportive learning environment with hands-on skill development​
Career-focused education aligned with physical therapy practice standards​
Hands-on training from day one to build real patient-care confidence​

settings.title: What You Will Learn in the Physical Therapist Assistant Program​

settings.editor:
You’ll develop the clinical, technical, and patient-care skills required to
support physical therapists and deliver safe, effective rehabilitative care
in real clinical settings.

• Anatomy & Physiology
  • Kinesiology
  • Pathology related to physical therapy
  • Principles of rehabilitation
  • Nursing ethics and patient safety
  • Professional ethics and patient safety​

• Therapeutic exercise techniques
  • Physical therapy modalities
  • Functional mobility training
  • Patient positioning and transfer
  • Gait training and mobility assistance
  • Clinical documentation

• Patient interaction and education
  • Team-based clinical collaboration
  • Professional communication in healthcare settings​
  • Clinical responsibility and ethics in patient care​

Apply your knowledge and skills in real healthcare environments
under professional supervision, gaining hands-on experience in
physical therapy practice.​
76 Credits | 1,785 Clock Hours​

image.alt: Physical therapist assistant guiding a patient through a resistance exercise

settings.editor:
• English I
  • Applied Mathematics​
  • Introduction to Psychology​
  • Human Anatomy & Physiology I + Lab​
  • Human Anatomy & Physiology II + Lab​
  • Healthcare Terminology​

• Introduction to Physical Therapist Assistant with Lab​
  • Applied Anatomy and Kinesiology with Lab​
    (Continued course list includes advanced clinical and therapeutic skills integrated throughout the program)​
    ​

Students participate in supervised clinical experiences in real
physical therapy settings, applying knowledge and skills in patient
care under professional guidance.​

settings.title: Career Outlook for Physical Therapist Assistants​

settings.editor:
Physical Therapist Assistants play an essential role in supporting
patient care under the direction and supervision of licensed
physical therapists.

Graduates of the Physical Therapist Assistant Program are prepared
to assist in the delivery of rehabilitative care in real healthcare
settings.
Possible Career Paths:​

• Physical Therapist Assistant
  • Rehabilitation Assistant​
  • Mobility Support Specialist​
  • Clinical Support Professional in Physical Therapy settings​
  • Outpatient Physical Therapy Team Member

Physical Therapist Assistants work in clinics, outpatient rehabilitation
centers, long-term care facilities, sports medicine settings, and other
healthcare environments where physical therapy services are provided.​

image.alt: Physical therapist assistant working with a pediatric patient

settings.editor:
• High school diploma, GED, or equivalent​

  • Successful criminal background check and drug screening
